newsitem.title: USA: Duke Realty buys three Ohio properties.
newsitem.headline: Duke Realty buys three Ohio properties.

text.p: Duke Realty Investments Inc said Tuesday it acquired two office and one industrial property in Ohio for a total investment of $29.2 million.
Duke Realty said the two office properties are in Cleveland and Columbus, Ohio, while the industrial property is in Cincinnati. Lease rates range from 93 percent to 100 percent, the company said.

Duke also reported the sale of two undeveloped parcels in Northern Kentucky and Nashville, Tennessee, and the sale of a Wal-Mart Stores Inc unit in Columbus, Ohio. The company received a total of $13.9 million from those deals, it said.
